title: Chinese Leader Xi Calls for U.S.-China Cooperation to Prevent AI Abuse
summary: <p>Chinese leader Xi Jinping said during his summit with U.S. President Donald Trump that the two nations can “jointly prevent the misuse and abuse of AI” through more cooperation.</p> <p>Trump and Xi held talks on Thursday at the White House, and a major topic on the agenda was AI safety and governance.</p> ...
